## What this lands

- **The corpus** (`tests/rdc/data/`, `sig.rdc-corpus/1`) — one
  licence-aware captured slice per recorded failure archetype where a
  licensed capture exists; the seven archetypes with no licensed
  capture yet are declared `deferred` and the three partials owe their
  second half — each naming its `D-P35.23-n` id (an unserved
  archetype is recorded, never silently absent).
  - **Committed lane** (bytes committed; `raw-ok` non-ODbL registry
    sources only): `camreg_dc_multiview` (DC CCTV two-page capture —
    collided-key + co-located multiview analogs),
    `camreg_nottingham_axis` (OGL-UK-3.0 — the 562-record axis-swap
    census), `eff_atlas_multistate`, `usaspending_topical`.
  - **Restricted lane** (digests + `sig:capture:` locators committed;
    bytes stay in the screened compartment bucket under
    `evidence/captures/`): `eff_data_driven_2016_2017`,
    `legistar_tenant_collision`, `osm_okc_surveillance` — ODbL material
    never leaves its compartment; only the digest is committed and
    the scheduled job derives the bytes at run time.
- **Pipeline-INDEPENDENT oracles** (`ops/src/ops/rdc_oracles.py`) —
  six oracles computing expected facts directly from captured source
  bytes; no pipeline/resolution import. The EFF oracle reads the ZIP
  in memory; the Legistar oracle treats cross-tenant
  `MatterFile`/`MatterId` sharing as a namespace collision, never one
  matter.
- **The corpus engine** (`ops/src/ops/rdc.py`) — `sig.rdc-slice/1` /
  `sig.rdc-snapshot/1` / `sig.rdc-report/1`: licence-lane validation,
  per-member sha256 verification (a corrupt member fails closed),
  snapshot pins + the named-approval verb (`snapshot approve`
  requires `--landed-in`/`--rationale`/`--rationale-ref` — snapshot
  changes land in their own explicit commit), report estimand lint
  (every report names its estimands verbatim + the SIG-CONF-012
  disclaimer — "never an estimate of real-world precision or
  recall"), vacuous-report refusal, OCFL derivation (on-disk +
  bucket, digest-verified before staging), the overlay corpus, and
  `run_scheduled` — the job leg: window re-check → derive → overlay →
  validate → full harness → `rdc-report.json` + `sig.probe-run/1` as
  new timestamped objects under `ops/probes/rdc/`; a suppressed fire
  still writes a `skipped` record — never a fake pass.
- **The harnesses** (`ops/src/ops/rdc_harness.py`) — **M-4**
  perturbation (per-class join/no-join census over modelled
  perturbations against the declared ruleset contract), **M-5**
  hard-negative (share of mechanically-declared known-distinct pairs
  the matcher merges — real co-located pairs), **M-6** metamorphic
  invariants over real collapses. Unmaterialized restricted slices
  defer honestly; a zero-evaluated run fails closed.
- **The scheduled lane** — `ops/rdc_probe.toml` (`sig.rdc-probe/1`),
  `ops/src/ops/rdc_job.py` (render + verify-describe/verify-trigger,
  reusing `quality_job.py`'s window predicates), `ops/gcp/rdc-slices.sh`
  (`--check` plan-only / `--apply` windowed + deps-gated exit-42 /
  `--verify` read-only / name-checked `rollback`), `ops/Dockerfile`
  (`COPY tests/rdc ./tests/rdc` — the image digest pins the corpus
  version), `ops/iam_identities.toml` (the RDC surface sits inside
  `sig-quality-probe-rt`'s existing conditioned grants — no new
  scope), `ops/gcp/config.sh` exports. Scheduler `15 1 1-5,14-31 *
  *` — 01:15Z days 1–5 + 14–31, structurally outside the batch
  window and the quiet band.
- **CLI** (`sig-ops rdc`) — `check [--materialized]` · `harness
  [--out|--emit|--skip-pipeline]` · `snapshot verify|approve` ·
  `derive` · `scheduled` · `job plan|render|verify-describe|
  verify-trigger`; `ops` gains the `sig-resolution` dep for the real
  ER leg.
- **Tests** — `tests/rdc/` (42): licence lanes, digest + corrupt
  refusal, empty-corpus fail-closed, oracle facts, snapshot
  tamper/missing/approve, estimand + vacuous lint, OCFL + bucket
  derivation, scheduled staging + both suppression windows +
  upload-under-conditioned-prefix, partition inclusion, M-4/5/6,
  pipeline-leg defect classes.

## Boundaries

Zero production writes or reads; the corpus slices are captured
bytes + digests — no live fetch; the restricted bytes derive only
inside the job from the screened compartment bucket; no licence
lane crossed (ODbL digests only, compartment respected); no
`ingestion_permitted` flip; no HG gate; mechanical censuses are
labelled estimands — never real-world accuracy claims; a fixture
green is never a live pass.
